parameters.description: Start of time range (ISO date format). Defaults to today if not provided.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: End of time range (ISO date format). Either `until` or `limit` must be provided.
parameters.name: until

parameters.description: Maximum number of available slots to return. Either `limit` or `until` must be provided.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Time zone for the slots (IANA format)
parameters.name: time_zone
